description: Implementation of the main logger class for a compact logging system, providing methods for various log levels, metadata handling, and transport management.

classes.name: CompactLogger
classes.description: Main logger class implementing ILogger, providing methods for logging at different levels, handling metadata, and managing transport.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new CompactLogger with optional transport and parent metadata.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug level message with optional metadata.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an info level message with optional metadata.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning level message with optional metadata.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error level message or Error object with optional metadata.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal level message or Error object with optional metadata.

methods.name: child
methods.description: Creates a child logger inheriting this logger's metadata.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the transport used by the logger.

methods.name: handleErrorLog
methods.description: Handles logging of error and fatal messages, processing Error objects.

methods.name: combineMeta
methods.description: Combines parent and current metadata, handling context precedence.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Core method that creates a log entry and writes it via transport.
